newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Kookmin issues GDRs at 27 pct premium.
newsitem.headline: Kookmin issues GDRs at 27 pct premium.

text.p: South Korea's Kookmin Bank issued a $300 million global depositary receipt (GDR) at a premium of 27 percent in London, co-lead manager Ssangyong Investment Securities said in a statement on Friday.
It said the price of one GDR was set at $23.30. Payment is scheduled for September 24.
The statement said the GDRs will be listed on the London Stock Exchange but gave no details.
A total of 23 domestic and foreign financial institutions participated as underwriters including Ssangyong and the other co-lead manager Merrill Lynch.
Proceeds from the sales of issue will be used to help finance domestic small- and mid-sized companies, the statement said.
